 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 24-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2 Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that during pendency of the bail petition,
both parties have resolved and settled their dispute in terms of settlement dated 16.2.2026, though copy of settlement has not been brought on the record.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.60448 of 2025(4) dt.24-02-2026 5.
Considering the aforesaid development, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.
